documents.title: Global Conference on Green Construction Materials and Practices 2027
documents.description:
The Global Conference on Green Construction Materials and Practices (GCGC 2027) will take place on 10–11 April 2027 in Karachi, Pakistan. The conference is jointly organized by UET Lahore and the National Center for Sustainable Construction Materials (NC4SCM).

The conference is intended for researchers and academics, civil and materials engineers, industry professionals, sustainability practitioners, students and emerging researchers, and policy and standards experts.

Conference tracks

Green construction materials: Low-carbon cementitious materials; Minerals and chemical admixtures; Waste-derived construction materials.

Sustainable construction: Performance and durability of sustainable structures; Modelling, simulation and digital engineering; Sustainable structural design and construction practices.

Case studies and best practices: Industrial decarbonisation and best practices; Policy, standards and green construction; Sustainable cities, climate action and case studies.

Proposed important dates

15 September 2026 — Call for papers opens

1 January 2027 — Paper submission deadline

15 January 2027 — First review decision

30 January 2027 — Revised paper submission

15 February 2027 — Final acceptance notification

25 February 2027 — Camera-ready submission

1 March 2027 — Author registration deadline

10–11 April 2027 — Conference

The important dates above are proposed. Please check the conference portal for updates.

Paper templates and Springer Nature proceedings guidelines are available on the conference website: https://gcgc.nc4scm.com. For enquiries, contact nc4scm@cloud.neduet.edu.pk.
